title: Living documentation project classification configuration
description: Optional .living-documentation.json at the project root. It affects classification, check scope, and Stop-hook enforcement; it never relocates project artifacts. This schema is the single source of truth for accepted keys: the bundled scripts read it at run time.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint pointing at this schema. Ignored by the scripts.

enforcement.description: How the Stop-hook gate treats this project: block (default) blocks unfinished documentation work a limited number of times, warn only shows a warning, off disables the gate and the session-start rule. The LIVING_DOCS_GATE environment variable overrides it.

exclude_globs.description: Extra paths to skip, in addition to the built-in exclusions. Patterns are matched against project-relative POSIX paths; a leading '**/' also matches at the top level.

specification_globs.description: Files to classify as authoritative specifications or contracts.

decision_globs.description: Files to classify as decision records.

evidence_globs.description: Files to classify as evidence (tests, benchmarks, validation).

generated_globs.description: Files to classify as generated artifacts.

infrastructure_globs.description: Files to classify as infrastructure, deployment, or CI definitions.

configuration_globs.description: Files to classify as configuration, build, or dependency manifests.
